definitions.full: H3288. yeaph יְעָף noun [masculine] weariness, faintness (Aramaism, according to Lag BN 175 ); — בִּיעָף מֻעָף weary with weariness , utterly weary Dan 9:21 (from winged flight, said of Gabriel). II. יעף (√ of following; compare Arabic ascend a mountain, hill ).
